title: だれでも～
shortExplanation: Used to express 'anyone' or 'everyone'; 'no matter who'.
longExplanation: The grammar point だれでも is used to emphasize that something applies to everyone or anyone, regardless of who they are. It can be translated as 'anyone', 'everyone', or 'no matter who' in English. It is used in sentences to show that a certain situation, characteristic, or condition applies to all people.

examples.jp: だれでもこのゲームができます。
examples.romaji: Dare demo kono geemu ga dekimasu.

examples.jp: だれでも疲れることがあります。
examples.romaji: Dare demo tsukareru koto ga arimasu.

examples.jp: だれでも無料でこのイベントに参加できます。
examples.romaji: Dare demo muryou de kono ibento ni sanka dekimasu.
examples.en: Anyone can participate in this event for free.

examples.jp: だれでもこの町の観光スポットを楽しむことができます。
examples.romaji: Dare demo kono machi no kankou supotto wo tanoshimu koto ga dekimasu.
examples.en: No matter who you are, you can enjoy the sightseeing spots in this town.
